_rule: External research says what the wider ecosystem does. It never overrides own-account analytics; disagreements are recorded.

findings.claim: Advent 2026 begins Sunday, November 29 (four Sundays: Nov 29, Dec 6, Dec 13, Dec 20; ends Christmas Eve), and week 2026-11-16 therefore sits in the two weeks just before Advent: the natural content bridge is 'gratitude month turning into hope/waiting month'.
findings.source: eClergys 'First Sunday of Advent 2026' (2026-10-06); Crosswalk 'First Sunday of Advent: November 29, 2026'; Common Good Magazine '2026 Advent Season' (2026-11-04)

findings.claim: The first Advent candle's theme is HOPE, and the verses writers reach for in hope-focused Advent devotionals include Isaiah 9:2, Isaiah 40:31, Jeremiah 33:14-16, Romans 15:13 and Titus 2:13; the liturgical Gospel for the first Sunday is Mark 13:33-37 (watchfulness). Useful as candidate verses for week 2026-11-16 if not already used.
findings.source: eClergys 'First Sunday of Advent 2026' (2026-10-06); christianity.com 'First Sunday of Advent - Readings and Prayers November 29th, 2026'

findings.claim: The November gratitude framing continues through Thanksgiving week (US Thanksgiving Thu Nov 26, 2026, three days before Advent): 2026 November devotionals are themed around gratitude in ordinary moments, trials and waiting seasons ('Gratitude & Praise: Living a Life of Thanksgiving', Jesus Bible Foundation 2026-10-24), and church-content guides stress gratitude 'when life is hard' and gratitude aimed at people, not only God.
findings.source: Jesus Bible Foundation Free Daily Devotional November 2026 (2026-10-24); Donorbox '7 Fresh & Popular Thanksgiving Sermon Ideas'; Church Media Squad '10 Thanksgiving and Gratitude Sermon Series Ideas' (2026-09-08)

findings.claim: Unanswered prayer and the fear of being forgotten in a waiting season remain a top emotional pain point in current Christian content: 'Has God heard me?' (The Realist Juggernaut, 2026-10-11) and 'A Prayer When You Feel Forgotten in a Waiting Season' (iBelieve/GodTube, 2026-10-13) build on Isaiah 49:15-16; the teaching emphasizes God's faithfulness is not measured by how fast circumstances change, and Scripture does not promise every desired outcome arrives if we wait long enough.
findings.source: The Realist Juggernaut Sunday Musing (2026-10-11); iBelieve 'Prayer for When You Feel Forgotten in a Waiting Season' (2026-10-13)

findings.claim: INFERENCE: with Advent start (Nov 29) and Thanksgiving (Nov 26) both in week 2026-11-23, week 2026-11-16 is the last quiet week: strongest lane is 'gratitude turning to hope' and waiting-season honesty; leave the pre-Advent 'hope candle' framing to the 2026-11-23 plan so the two weeks do not overlap.
